about.subtitle: A Sydney entrepreneur is building the AI-powered rental marketplace that migrants, students, and professionals deserve.
about.storyP1: MigRent AI started from a simple frustration: finding a room in a new country shouldn't feel like a full-time job. Scrolling through endless Facebook groups, dealing with scammers on classifieds, and getting rejected because you don't have local references — it's a broken system.
about.storyP2: Founded in Sydney in 2025, MigRent was built by someone who experienced these challenges firsthand. The idea was straightforward: what if technology could match the right seekers with the right rooms, build trust through verification, and make the whole process faster and safer?
about.storyP3: That's what MigRent does. We use AI to analyse preferences, lifestyle compatibility, and trust signals to create meaningful matches. Owners get serious, pre-qualified enquiries instead of noise. Seekers get curated rooms that actually fit their needs and budget.
about.storyP4: We launched with Sydney and expanded to Adelaide in 2026. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for short- to medium-term accommodation across Australia — and eventually beyond.
about.missionText: To make finding accommodation in Australia faster, safer, and fairer for everyone — especially those arriving without local rental history. We believe everyone deserves a trusted path to finding a place to call home.
about.value1Desc: We know what it's like to arrive in a new country with no rental history. MigRent exists because the current system fails newcomers.
about.value2Desc: We use AI matching and optional verification to create a safer, more transparent rental experience for everyone.
about.value3Desc: Simple, one-time fees. No subscriptions, no commissions on rent. Owners keep 100% of ongoing payments.
about.value4Desc: We're not just a platform — we're building a community where people help each other find home in a new place.
about.howDesc: MigRent is a matching platform. We connect room owners with accommodation seekers and use AI to make that connection smarter.
about.howSeekerDesc: Create a profile, browse AI-matched rooms, connect with owners directly.
about.howOwnerDesc: List your room for free, receive pre-qualified enquiries, pay $99 per match.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.noResults: No questions match your search. Try different keywords or
faq.stillSubtitle: Our team is here to help with anything not covered above.
faq.cat1a1: MigRent AI is an online matching platform that connects room owners with accommodation seekers for short- to medium-term rooms across Australia. We use AI to help match seekers with suitable rooms.
faq.cat1q2: Is MigRent a real estate agent?
faq.cat1a2: No. MigRent AI is a matching platform only. We are not a real estate agent, landlord, tenant, or a party to any tenancy or licence agreement.
faq.cat1q3: How do I create an account?
faq.cat1a3: Click 'Sign Up' on the homepage, enter your email, and verify it. You can then complete your profile as either a seeker, owner, or both.
faq.cat1q4: Can I be both a seeker and an owner?
faq.cat1a4: Yes! You can switch between seeker and owner roles from your dashboard at any time.
faq.cat1a5: MigRent currently operates in Sydney and Adelaide, Australia, with plans to expand to other cities.
faq.cat1a6: Creating an account and browsing is free. Platform fees apply when a successful match is made — see our Pricing page for details.
faq.cat2q1: How do I find a room?
faq.cat2a1: Once logged in, go to the Seeker Dashboard. Browse listings, use filters (location, price, room type), and view AI match scores to find rooms that suit you.
faq.cat2q2: What does the match score mean?
faq.cat2a2: The match score is an AI-calculated percentage that estimates how well a listing matches your preferences (location, budget, lifestyle). It's a guide, not a guarantee.
faq.cat2q3: Do I need to verify my identity?
faq.cat2a3: Verification is optional but recommended. Verified seekers get higher trust scores and are more likely to be chosen by owners.
faq.cat2q4: How much does it cost as a seeker?
faq.cat2a4: Seekers may be presented with an optional one-time AUD $19 verification fee. This is always clearly disclosed before payment.
faq.cat2q5: How do I contact an owner?
faq.cat2a5: Use the messaging feature on the platform to send a message to the owner directly. Keep communication on the platform for safety.
faq.cat2q6: What if a listing looks suspicious?
faq.cat2a6: Use the Report button on any listing or profile. You can also email us at migrentau@gmail.com. We investigate all reports.
faq.cat2q7: Can I save listings for later?
faq.cat2a7: Yes! Click the heart icon on any listing to save it to your wishlist. Access saved listings from your dashboard.
faq.cat2q8: What should I check before paying rent?
faq.cat2a8: Always inspect the property (in person or via video call), verify the owner's identity, agree on all terms in writing, and understand bond, bills, and notice periods.
faq.cat3q1: How do I list a room?
faq.cat3a1: Go to the Owner Dashboard, click 'Create Listing', and fill in the details — location, price, photos, description, and house rules. Your listing will be visible to seekers immediately.
faq.cat3q2: How much does it cost to list?
faq.cat3a2: Listing is free. Owners pay a one-time AUD $99 platform fee only when a successful match is confirmed through MigRent.
faq.cat3q3: When is the owner fee charged?
faq.cat3a3: The AUD $99 fee is charged when a deal is confirmed through the platform. You are not charged for listing or receiving enquiries.
faq.cat3q4: How do I choose the right seeker?
faq.cat3a4: Review seeker profiles, verification status, and match scores. Use the messaging feature to ask questions and conduct your own due diligence.
faq.cat3a5: Yes, you can create multiple listings for different rooms or properties.
faq.cat3q6: How do I manage my listing?
faq.cat3a6: Go to the Owner Dashboard to edit, pause, or remove your listings at any time.
faq.cat3a7: Include clear, current photos, accurate pricing, detailed description, and be upfront about house rules, bills, and conditions.
faq.cat3q8: How can I earn Superhost status?
faq.cat3a8: Complete at least 3 successful matches, maintain full verification, have no active reports, and respond to messages within 24 hours.
faq.cat4a1: All platform fees are processed securely through Stripe. We never store your full credit card details.
faq.cat4a2: Platform fees are generally non-refundable once a deal is confirmed. In exceptional circumstances, refunds may be considered at our discretion. Contact migrentau@gmail.com.
faq.cat4a3: Yes, Stripe automatically sends a receipt to your email address after each payment.
faq.cat4q4: Is MigRent involved in rent payments?
faq.cat4a4: No. All ongoing rent payments are arranged directly between owners and seekers. MigRent only charges a one-time platform fee on match.
faq.cat4a5: A match is considered successful when both parties confirm the arrangement through the platform's deal confirmation process.
faq.cat4q6: What if someone tries to avoid the platform fee?
faq.cat4a6: Using MigRent to find a match and then deliberately moving off-platform to avoid fees is a violation of our Terms. This may result in account suspension.
faq.cat5a1: We offer email verification (required), profile completion badges, and optional ID verification through third-party providers.
faq.cat5a2: Yes. We follow the Australian Privacy Act and applicable GDPR standards. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
faq.cat5a3: VEVO (Visa Entitlement Verification Online) is an Australian government service. MigRent may use VEVO-connected services to verify visa status for applicable users.
faq.cat5q4: How do I report a problem?
faq.cat5a4: Use the Report button on any listing or profile, or contact us at migrentau@gmail.com. We take all reports seriously.
faq.cat5a5: If you feel unsafe, contact local emergency services (000) immediately. Then report the situation to MigRent.
faq.cat5a6: No. Verification badges and trust scores are informational tools to help decision-making. They do not guarantee safety or suitability.
faq.cat6q1: I can't log in — what should I do?
faq.cat6a1: Try resetting your password from the sign-in page. If the issue persists, contact us at migrentau@gmail.com.
faq.cat6q2: How do I delete my account?
faq.cat6a2: Go to Account Settings and click 'Delete Account'. Your data will be removed within 30 days per our Privacy Policy.
faq.cat6q3: Can I change my email address?
faq.cat6a3: Contact us at migrentau@gmail.com to request an email change. We'll verify your identity before making the change.
faq.cat6q4: Does MigRent have a mobile app?
faq.cat6a4: MigRent is a responsive web app that works great on mobile browsers. A native app is on our roadmap.
faq.cat6q5: How do I switch between light and dark mode?
faq.cat6a5: Click the sun/moon icon in the top navigation bar to toggle between themes.
faq.cat6q6: Who do I contact for support?
faq.cat6a6: Email us at migrentau@gmail.com or use the contact form on our Contact page. We aim to respond within 24 hours.
